nights.title: Emrah
nights.name: Emrah
nights.extract: Emrah Erdoğan İpek is a Turkish-Kurdish singer, actor and child star during 1980's from Turkey..

nights.title: Gökhan Türkmen
nights.name: Gökhan Türkmen
nights.extract: Gökhan Türkmen is a Turkish singer.

nights.title: Serdar Ortaç
nights.name: Serdar Ortaç
nights.extract:
Serdar Ortaç is a Turkish singer, songwriter and composer from Istanbul.
He is known as one of the most popular singers in Turkish pop-music history.

nights.title: Aşkın Nur Yengi
nights.name: Aşkın Nur Yengi
nights.extract:
Aşkın Nur Yengi is a Turkish singer, composer, and actress.
She started working as a backing vocalist for Sezen Aksu and with Aksu's help, released her first studio album in 1990. With her debut album Sevgiliye in 1990, she became one of the most successful Turkish singers of the '90s.

nights.title: Lil Zey
nights.name: Lil Zey
nights.extract: Zeynep Tanyalçın, better known by her stage name Lil Zey, is a Turkish rapper, singer and songwriter.

nights.title: Zakkum
nights.name: Zakkum
nights.extract: Zakkum are a Turkish rock group. It was created in 1999 under the name Raindog in Ankara. Raindog had many stage performances, before they started working on an album and chose a Turkish name "Zakkum" for their band.
